content.text: Just got off work and made a simple dinner. My bowl of soup is still steaming hot. Have you started eating yet?
Coincidentally, I just finished making it too. Following the recipe you shared last time—simple and comforting.
Looks good, the red of the tomatoes is very vibrant. How is Chen Pi doing today?
Much better, my appetite has improved a bit. Thanks to the weekly schedule you suggested earlier, administering medication and monitoring have become much more regular.
That's good. Systematic recording can indeed reduce anxiety. The dinner atmosphere over there seems quite cozy.
Well, I enjoy these moments of slowing down. The breakfast style on your tray reminds me of the feeling of eating at home when I was a child.
Rationally speaking, trays can improve efficiency and reduce spills. However, I haven't deliberately thought about the sense of nostalgia you mentioned.
There's always poetry in the details. By the way, have you been busy with work lately? Any progress on algorithm optimization?
I'm working on advancing a medical data analysis project, hoping to use technology to improve the diagnostic process. How about the manuscript you're editing?
Still refining the details, aiming to capture a sense of heritage in everyday life. Just like caring for aged tangerine peel, even the mundane holds value in its documentation.
In terms of the empirical spirit, I agree. From PetPace to recipes, data accumulation can lead to better decisions.
Thank you for always helping. This bowl of noodles reminds me of the corn silk porridge you recommended—simple yet nourishing.
You're welcome. Optimizing life is also part of technology for good. Do you usually watch movies? It can help you relax.
Occasionally, I watch some old movies, the ones with a slow pace. How about you?
I prefer science fiction or documentaries, as they are more logical. However, chatting while eating feels like an informal ritual.
Yes, silent companionship. Can we sync up like this again at the next dinner time?
Alright, just set a reminder. Keep making progress. Your noodle soup looks like it's getting cold, so go ahead and eat first.
Well, you should eat it while it's hot too. This kind of daily connection makes me feel quite at ease.
Agreed. From the tangerine peel incident to our meals, our collaboration is becoming increasingly smooth. Good night, Qing Yan.
Good night, Zhixing. Thank you for your company today.
